006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import java.time.DateTimeException;
011import java.time.OffsetTime;
012import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
013import java.util.List;
014
015import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITimeWithTimeZoneItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
019import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
020import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
022
023/**
024 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
025 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date-time-with-timezone">date-time-with-timezone</a>
026 * data type.
027 */
028public class TimeWithTZAdapter
029    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<OffsetTime, ITimeWithTimeZoneItem> {
030  @NonNull
031  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
032      List.of(
033          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "time-with-timezone")));
034
035  TimeWithTZAdapter() {
036    super(OffsetTime.class, ITimeWithTimeZoneItem.class, ITimeWithTimeZoneItem::cast);
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
041    return NAMES;
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
046    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
047  }
048
049  @SuppressWarnings("null")
050  @Override
051  public OffsetTime parse(String value) {
052    try {
053      return OffsetTime.from(DateFormats.TIME_WITH_TZ.parse(value));
054    } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
055      throw new IllegalArgumentException(ex.getLocalizedMessage(), ex);
056    }
057  }
058
059  @SuppressWarnings("null")
060  @Override
061  public String asString(Object value) {
062    try {
063      return DateFormats.TIME_WITH_TZ.format(toValue(value));
064    } catch (DateTimeException ex) {
065      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
066          String.format("The provided value '%s' cannot be formatted as a time value. %s",
067              value.toString(),
068              ex.getMessage()),
069          ex);
070    }
071  }
072
073  @SuppressWarnings("null")
074  @Override
075  public OffsetTime copy(Object obj) {
076    return OffsetTime.from((OffsetTime) obj);
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public ITimeWithTimeZoneItem newItem(Object value) {
081    OffsetTime item = toValue(value);
082    return ITimeWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(item);
083  }
084}
